question: What fault is identified when promised wealth is not delivered at the times of the rite?
premises: Wealth may be promised at rite times.
Giving is expected at those times.
Non-delivery of that wealth is named as a fault.
inference: Failing to deliver promised wealth at the times of the rite constitutes non-delivery.
uncertainties: The consequence of non-delivery is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: At the times of the rite, having promised wealth, not delivering it is a fault.
